Affidavit of service filed by the petitioner is taken on  record.

It is contended on behalf of the petitioner that the  land of the petitioner was requisitioned in terms of the West Bengal Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948  but the land was not acquired subsequently.

sentences.text: In the  meantime the said Act of 1948 stood repealed with effect  from March 31, 1997 and the scheme for which such  requisition was made was abandoned.

The petitioner submitted a representation before the  concerned authority on 29th May, 2023 praying for release  of his land and payment of compensation but the  representation is yet to be considered.

The petitioner  prays for a direction upon the concerned authority to Sachindranath Ghosh vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162651339/
1  consider the representation at the earliest.

sentences.text: In view of the above, the writ petition is disposed of  directing the 4th respondent to consider and dispose of the representation submitted by the petitioner on 29 th May, 2023 within a period of three months from the date of communication of this order upon affording reasonable opportunity of hearing to all the interested persons including the petitioner, in accordance with law.
In the event the representation is decided in favour of the petitioner, necessary consequential steps be taken by the 4th respondent within a month thereof.
There shall be, however, no order as to costs.
Since no affidavit is invited, the allegations contained in the petition are deemed not to be admitted.

opennyai_summary.facts:
It is contended on behalf of the petitioner that the  land of the petitioner was requisitioned in terms of the West Bengal Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948  but the land was not acquired subsequently.
The petitioner submitted a representation before the  concerned authority on 29th May, 2023 praying for release  of his land and payment of compensation but the  representation is yet to be considered.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In the  meantime the said Act of 1948 stood repealed with effect  from March 31, 1997 and the scheme for which such  requisition was made was abandoned.
In view of the above, the writ petition is disposed of  directing the 4th respondent to consider and dispose of the representation submitted by the petitioner on 29 th May, 2023 within a period of three months from the date of communication of this order upon affording reasonable opportunity of hearing to all the interested persons including the petitioner, in accordance with law.
In the event the representation is decided in favour of the petitioner, necessary consequential steps be taken by the 4th respondent within a month thereof.
There shall be, however, no order as to costs.
Since no affidavit is invited, the allegations contained in the petition are deemed not to be admitted.
